name: myst-dev-kit
description: A skills library for agentic delivery: spec -> tickets -> triage -> implement -> verify -> review/publish, plus engineering skills (TDD, design, debugging, grilling) and a vendored two-axis code-review engine. Protocols are VCS-agnostic with Perforce and git command forms. Skills only - no agents, commands, hooks, or scripts; Codex runs the review sub-agents natively via multi-agent v2. Install: the paste block in the repo README.

interface.shortDescription: Myst team skills library for agentic delivery and review
